description: Department of Animal Production and Health - Amended Extra Gazette No. 2409/02 of 04.11.2024 Animal Diseases Act, No.59 of 1992.
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment and enforcement of regulations under the Animal Diseases Act, No. 59 of 1992. It declares specific disease control measures, prohibits certain activities, and establishes legal requirements and procedures - all characteristic of legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
